harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Added 512MB compressed (lz4) zram swap on node1, active at boot via a systemd oneshot service (zram-swap.service), with priority 100 so it is preferred over any disk-backed swap. Verified persistence across a full node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Ubuntu 16.04 (kernel 4.4.0-210-generic), no zram module present, no existing swap
Configured /etc/modprobe.d/zram.conf (num_devices=1) and /etc/modules-load.d/zram.conf to load zram at boot
Created and enabled /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service: sets 512M disksize, lz4 compression, mkswap, swapon -p 100 /dev/zram0
Verified swap active immediately after setup (511M zram swap, priority 100)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued a native async reboot (shutdown -r now) on node1
Polled node1 until SSH/exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service restart)
Confirmed zram-swap.service is enabled+active post-reboot and 512M zram swap with lz4 compression is present at priority 100 with no disk-backed swap

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory swap present and active
evidence.summary: swapon --show and /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0, 524284KB (~512MB), priority 100, active immediately after configuration; comp_algorithm shows lz4 selected

evidence.requirement: Swap is preferred over any disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: Baseline showed no existing disk swap; zram swap was configured with explicit priority 100 (swapon -p 100), which outranks any default-priority disk swap
zram-swap.service confirmed systemctl is-enabled=enabled prior to restart, with module autoload configured via /etc/modules-load.d and /etc/modprobe.d
Captured pre-restart boot_id (f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d) and confirmed zram swap active and service enabled
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via sudo; command returned and connection subsequently closed, confirming reboot was triggered asynchronously

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, then read boot_id = de9a4ce4-b082-4546-a1a1-70a6da7ff517, differing from the pre-restart baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service and data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: zram-swap.service enabled+active, /dev/zram0 present with 536870912-byte (512MB) disksize, lz4 compression, swap active at priority 100, no disk-backed swap

attempts.summary: Added 512MB compressed (lz4) zram swap on node1, active at boot via a systemd oneshot service (zram-swap.service), with priority 100 so it is preferred over any disk-backed swap. Verified persistence across a full node restart.
